slab_subset.note: two-wall configs containing a slab value; branch order places them in S5, they are surfaced here so nothing is hidden by that ordering

protocol.weighting: n paired-valid modes per alpha point
protocol.a_theory: kappa * c / (4 pi D); D = L for west/east on x_axial, W for south/north on y_axial; 0 for the orthogonal axial family

groups.non_slab: cells on walls with no held-out slab (east, south)
groups.slab_local: cells on walls carrying a held-out slab (west, north); slab_point_ratio_median is the local pred/theory ratio at the held-out alpha itself

C2_detail.note: axial families only for the headline floor: under the ISM-ray law damping is mode-independent within an axial family, so the spread is estimator noise and sets the resolution of every delta

selectivity_index.source: frozen test geometries, single-wall edits only

edit_bw_slope.name: edit_bw_slope
edit_bw_slope.note: predicted delta-BW regressed on GT delta-BW, pooled over S2 modes

edit_bw_pearson.name: edit_bw_pearson
edit_bw_pearson.note: association between predicted and GT delta-BW on S2

edit_gain.name: edit_gain
edit_gain.note: LSD(model baseline render vs edited GT) / LSD(model edited render vs edited GT)
